# CF TanStack Starter

> Full-stack starter template running on Cloudflare Workers: TanStack Start
> (React SSR + server functions), D1 (SQLite), R2 (object storage), KV
> (feature flags + rate limiting), Drizzle ORM, better-auth, and shadcn/ui.

This file follows https://llmstxt.org — a machine-readable site overview for
LLM agents. Replace its contents with a description of YOUR site when you
build on this template.

## Pages

- [Home](/): landing page describing the stack
- [Demo](/demo): live D1 guestbook and R2 file upload demo
- [Login](/login), [Register](/register): username/password auth (better-auth)

## For contributors

- Source layout, conventions, and commands: see AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in the repository root
- Admin panel lives under /admin (session + admin role required)
- API endpoints under /api/ are documented in the repository README
